llm.summary: The skill appears to provide a local resilience monitoring dashboard, with minor transparency and trigger-scope issues but no evidence of malicious behavior.

dimensions.detail: The reported dashboard capability fits the apparent purpose of monitoring operational errors, retries, and recovery state.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some example phrases appear broad enough to open the dashboard from generic monitoring requests, so users may see the UI invoked unexpectedly.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No risky installer, package script, or automatic privileged setup was identified from the supplied telemetry.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Opening a localhost dashboard may display operational metadata such as error logs, model names, retry status, or recovery details; this is purpose-aligned but should be disclosed clearly.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No evidence of persistence, privilege escalation, credential harvesting, destructive actions, or external exfiltration was provided.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a local dashboard for resilience/error monitoring. Avoid opening it during screen sharing or on shared machines, and prefer explicit commands such as opening the resilience dashboard rather than generic monitoring phrases.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: A browser-based local dashboard is expected for a resilience monitoring tool, but users should be warned that visible operational metadata may be sensitive on shared screens or machines.
[SQP-1] expected: Dashboard-opening examples are related to the tool's purpose, but generic trigger phrasing increases the chance of surprising UI launch and should be narrowed or confirmed.
